recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white composition featuring a rear-view silhouette of a figure in a sweatshirt with one arm raised in victory, set against a snowy urban park landscape, topped by massive, tightly-packed sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The raised fist physically interacts with the negative space between the large letters.
The stark black of the figure and text anchors the top and bottom against a bright, hazy background.
The verticality of the raised arm leads the eye directly into the primary typographic block.
coreInvariants: Strict monochrome palette (pure black and white).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the lower two-thirds, medium shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, black block-lettering at the top acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's back, follows the raised arm upward to the large text, then settles on the smaller subtitle text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright, overexposed sky and snowy ground provide high-contrast negative space that defines the dark silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure Black for silhouettes and typography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-key White/Light Gray for the background and atmospheric haze.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Maximum value contrast with no mid-tone saturation; grainy texture provides the only tonal gradation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-heavy wide display type and clean, condensed subtitle type.

preserve: Extreme weight of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, sturdy, American gothic feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and weight for the subtitle.
Alternative for the display text if a more geometric look is desired.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, high-contrast black and white photograph from behind a person in a dark hoodie with one arm raised in a victory fist. They are standing at the top of stone steps overlooking a snowy, hazy park with bare trees and distant city structures. The sky is blown out to pure white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of massive, ultra-bold black sans-serif text at the top, justified to the width of the frame. Add a smaller line of bold condensed black text aligned to the right, positioned just below the main title block.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the main text heavy enough to dominate the top third?
Does the arm lead the eye toward the text?
Is there a visible film grain texture?

adjustableVariables: Height of the subject in the frame
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Busy backgrounds that obscure the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's head.
Check that the white background is bright enough to make the black text pop.
Verify the grainy texture is consistent across the image.
Confirm the arm gesture is clearly defined as a fist.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast monochrome photo of a triumphant silhouette + Apply massive, tight-kerning sans-serif headers + Add film grain for a cinematic documentary aesthetic.
